mintAuthority.summary: sUSN is Noon's staking wrapper over USN. Shares mint against deposited USN and inherit the reviewed MinterHandlerV2 and 3-of-6 Noon admin Safe. The Ethereum wrapper is a transparent proxy whose ProxyAdmin is governed by a 48-hour timelock owned by that Safe.

controls.label: Noon sUSN transparent proxy
controls.capDescription: Transparent proxy; upgrade path: ProxyAdmin (0x1908284b) → owner 0xe5e412c → owner Safe 0x1ea169. Wrapper owner() also returns the same 3/6 Safe.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530817, the wrapper implementation slot returned 0xd1ffb6...5b34 and the admin slot returned ProxyAdmin 0x190828...bd81. The wrapper itself has no separate privileged base-USN mint path; its supply is issued through the staking deposit flow.

controls.label: Inherited USN MinterHandlerV2
controls.capDescription: Inherited USN MinterHandlerV2 minting is bounded by the parent USN handler's per-block/per-day and whitelist controls, which Noon admin controls can update.
controls.evidence: Inherited from the reviewed usn-noon mintAuthority. Verified MinterHandlerV2 source enforces per-block, per-day, whitelisted-user, and collateral checks; the handler itself does not hold DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

controls.label: Inherited Noon admin Safe
controls.evidence: The parent USN review confirms this 3-of-6 Safe holds MinterHandlerV2 MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, so it can execute bounded mints and change the handler's limits. Current Safe reads show six owners, threshold 3, no enabled modules, and a zero guard.

controls.label: sUSN Ethereum upgrade timelock
controls.evidence: At block 25530817, the sUSN proxy admin slot returned ProxyAdmin 0x190828...bd81; its owner was the verified Noon timelock 0xe5e412...15a7f. delay() returned 172800 seconds and owner() returned the Noon 3-of-6 admin Safe.

review.evidence: The sUSN wrapper mints only against deposited USN and inherits the parent MinterHandlerV2 plus Noon 3-of-6 admin Safe. At Ethereum block 25530817, its transparent proxy resolved to implementation 0xd1ffb6...5b34 and ProxyAdmin 0x190828...bd81; the ProxyAdmin owner was a verified 172800-second timelock owned by the same Safe. Non-Ethereum contracts are reviewed as third-party bridge representations, not independent issuer mint paths. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: local sUSN supply is deposit-gated, mint-logic replacement is enforced through the 48-hour timelock, and live ERC-4626 accounting covers all wrapper shares through Accountable without a named prudential supervisor.
